Officer '''Mayin Yerol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], serving in the [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] as a stims [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]].
